result.summary: A narrow one-way residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. The environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings and has significant visual obstructions due to on-street parking.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars and vans along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs of the street.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or potential crossing points to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a residential corner with continuous sidewalks but lacks marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices. Parked vehicles near the intersection may obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner block sightlines for both pedestrians attempting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line near the corner.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at the intersection reduces driver awareness of potential pedestrian activity.
hazards.location_in_image: The intersection area in the foreground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental) crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten crossing distances and prevent illegal parking near the corner.

result.summary: This narrow residential street features continuous sidewalks but lacks any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as markings or ramps. While the narrow roadway likely moderates vehicle speeds, the presence of parked cars and a lack of visible lighting or signage reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks or signage to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can block sightlines between pedestrians entering the street and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and weed growth at the curb line create uneven surfaces for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Curb line on the right side

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility during nighttime hours.

result.summary: This is a narrow residential street with row housing and sidewalks on both sides. While the low-speed environment is inherently safer than a major arterial, it lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and clear sightlines at the intersection due to parked vehicles.
